variables.name: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
variables.title: GitHub Personal Access Token
variables.description: GitHub fine-grained or classic PAT with repo, issues, pull_requests, and actions read/write scopes (stored in your OS Keyring).

variables.name: ACADEMIC_CORPUS_DB_PATH
variables.title: Academic Corpus SQLite DB Path
variables.description: Local path to your SQLite academic_corpus.db file (e.g., ~/development/heimdall-astro/data/papers/academic_corpus.db). Initialized automatically if absent.

variables.name: ADS_API_TOKEN
variables.title: NASA ADS API Token
variables.description: API token from NASA Astrophysics Data System (ui.adsabs.harvard.edu -> Account -> Settings -> API Token).

variables.name: ZOTERO_API_KEY
variables.title: Zotero API Key
variables.description: Private Zotero Web API key with library read/write access.

variables.name: ZOTERO_LIBRARY_ID
variables.title: Zotero Library ID
variables.description: Numeric Zotero userID or groupID shown on your Zotero API keys settings page.

variables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID
variables.title: Google OAuth Client ID
variables.description: Desktop OAuth 2.0 Client ID from Google Cloud Console for Google Workspace APIs.

variables.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_SECRET
variables.title: Google OAuth Client Secret
variables.description: Desktop OAuth 2.0 Client Secret paired with GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID.

variables.name: USER_GOOGLE_EMAIL
variables.title: Google Account Email
variables.description: Primary Google Workspace / Gmail address used for single-user OAuth sessions.
